messages:
jen: quick heads-up — onboarding a customer on Dedicated behind a corporate proxy. our python async sample passes locally but fails in their k8s with SSL: CERTIFICATE_VERIFY_FAILED. using AsyncClient and aiohttp.

kai: are you setting SSL_CERT_FILE / REQUESTS_CA_BUNDLE in the pod? also are you passing base_url or using REDWOOD_BASE_URL?

jen: passing base_url. I tried SSL_CERT_FILE pointing at the mounted CA and HTTPS_PROXY set. still fails. minimal snippet:```python
from redwood import AsyncClient
async def main():
    c = AsyncClient(base_url=\"https://dedicated.example.com\", api_key=\"***\")
    await c.generate(\"test\")
```
no explicit connector args in sample.

ben: aiohttp will not automatically pick up SSL_CERT_FILE in every environment. quick workaround: create an ssl.SSLContext and pass via connector_args, e.g.```python
import ssl
ssl_ctx = ssl.create_default_context(cafile='/etc/pki/custom-ca.pem')
client = AsyncClient(..., connector_args={'ssl': ssl_ctx})
```
that fixed it for a previous customer.

jen: that works for me too when I mount the CA and build the context. but customers expect env var flow to \"just work\" — we should read SSL_CERT_FILE by default for async path.

kai: agree. small DX proposals: 1) add truststore_path param (typed) to AsyncClient constructor 2) have async client fallback to SSL_CERT_FILE if connector_args['ssl'] missing 3) document k8s initContainer snippet for Debian/Alpine to add CA to OS store.

ben: also found a bug: token refresh codepath used a different HTTP session and didn't inherit the ssl context, which caused refresh attempts to fail via proxy. should make refresh reuse the same connector/ssl context.

jen: filed a quick repro + logs in GH and linked internal doc. devx-bot: created issue https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk-python/issues/4800 — \"py-sdk: truststore_path param + async fallback to SSL_CERT_FILE; ensure refresh reuses ssl context\" (assign kai).

devx-bot: noted follow-ups: add typed connector_args: Optional[Mapping[str, Any]]; add example in examples/onprem/k8s-init.yaml.

jen: thanks — workaround landed for the customer, will watch for the SDK patch.
